observations: Photo 0: a single light-colored, clean wooden pallet on a polished concrete floor, no visible wear or staining.
Photo 1: the same or a very similar new-looking pallet, close-up, showing clean fastener heads and unweathered wood.
Photo 2: a stacked pile of multiple wooden pallets outdoors, wood is dark, weathered, with visible wear, stains, and some broken or loose boards.
No visible ISPM-15 heat-treatment stamp or size markings on any pallet.
Watermark 'DANTILA RESOURCES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appear on all photos; this is the seller's branding, not a product brand.
No ruler, tape measure, or reference object for scale in any photo.

claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing
claims.evidence: Generic marketing statement, not a claim about this specific item's condition, size, or count.

risks.risk: Mismatch between the clean new-looking pallet in photos 0-1 and the worn, stacked, weathered pallets in photo 2 — unclear which condition the buyer will actually receive.
risks.proof: A single current photo of the exact pallet(s) to be delivered, taken today, alongside a note of quantity.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the worse condition shown (used/weathered, as in photo 2)

risks.risk: Unknown pallet dimensions (standard sizes vary widely and change price per unit).
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure against the pallet length and width.
risks.if_unproven: priced as smallest common standard size

risks.risk: Unknown quantity being sold (per single pallet vs a bulk lot as suggested by the stack in photo 2).
risks.proof: Seller's explicit statement of unit count matched to a photo of that exact count.

risks.risk: No heat-treatment (ISPM-15) stamp visible, which matters if pallets are for export or regulated shipping.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any stamp/brand burned into the block or board.

risks.risk: Structural integrity of boards and blocks not inspectable for cracks, rot, or loose nails, especially in the stacked old pallets.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the underside and corner blocks of the actual pallet(s) being sold.
risks.if_unproven: priced as functional but cosmetically worn, not structurally guaranteed

proof_requests: A clear photo of the exact pallet(s) to be delivered, taken now, showing condition and any stamps.
A photo with a tape measure showing length and width.
Confirmation of exact quantity included, matched with a photo showing that count.
response.reason: The photos show two different pallet conditions (new in 0-1, worn/stacked in 2) with no stated size or quantity, so even a worst-case price cannot be fixed until the seller confirms which pallet and how many are actually for sale.
